ChildCategories.Name: Resistor Networks, Arrays
ChildCategories.SeoDescription: Resistor networks or arrays are devices of two or more resistors in a single surface mount or through-hole package. The resistors may be isolated from each other or connected in an R2R ladder (digital to analog converter), bussed, voltage divider, dual terminator, digital-to-analog converter, or decade resistor circuit type. Single or multiple resistance values range from zero (jumper) to 5 GΩ and 0.1% to 15% tolerance.
